package domain

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"regexp"
	"strings"
	"time"

	"github.com/google/uuid"
)

const (
	DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchema = "diagnostic-assessment-plan.v1"
	DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy     = "diagnostic-fixed-v1"
	DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicy = "diagnostic-placement-band-v1"
	DiagnosticBootstrapPolicy      = "diagnostic-bootstrap-v1"
)

var diagnosticSHA256 = regexp.MustCompile(`^sha256:[0-9a-f]{64}$`)
var diagnosticTargetKey = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9._:/-]{0,254}$`)

// DiagnosticAssessmentPlan is an immutable, Planner-issued placement plan. It
// intentionally contains references only; definitions and answer keys remain
// in Course.
type DiagnosticAssessmentPlan struct {
	Schema                 string                         `json:"schema"`
	ID                     string                         `json:"id"`
	StudentID              string                         `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID               string                         `json:"course_id"`
	PlanRevision           int                            `json:"plan_revision"`
	PolicyVersion          string                         `json:"policy_version"`
	OnboardingVersion      int64                          `json:"onboarding_version"`
	BootstrapPolicyVersion string                         `json:"bootstrap_policy_version"`
	BootstrapContextDigest string                         `json:"bootstrap_context_digest"`
	CourseContentRevision  string                         `json:"course_content_revision"`
	PlanDigest             string                         `json:"plan_digest"`
	Assessments            []DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem `json:"assessments"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time                      `json:"created_at"`
}

type DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem struct {
	LessonID        string              `json:"lesson_id"`
	TaskID          string              `json:"task_id"`
	TaskVersion     int64               `json:"task_version"`
	UpdatedAt       time.Time           `json:"updated_at"`
	LessonOrder     int                 `json:"lesson_order"`
	TaskOrder       int                 `json:"task_order"`
	LearningTargets []LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
}

// DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog is Course's safe active diagnostic projection.
type DiagnosticAssessmentCatalog struct {
	Schema             string                            `json:"schema"`
	CourseID           string                            `json:"course_id"`
	CurriculumRevision string                            `json:"curriculum_revision"`
	Items              []DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogItem `json:"items"`
}
type DiagnosticAssessmentCatalogItem struct {
	LessonID          string              `json:"lesson_id"`
	TaskID            string              `json:"task_id"`
	TaskVersion       int64               `json:"task_version"`
	UpdatedAt         time.Time           `json:"updated_at"`
	LessonOrder       int                 `json:"lesson_order"`
	TaskOrder         int                 `json:"task_order"`
	Type              int16               `json:"type"`
	AssessmentPurpose string              `json:"assessment_purpose"`
	LearningTargets   []LearningTargetRef `json:"learning_targets"`
}

type DiagnosticAssessmentAttempt struct {
	Schema                 string                         `json:"schema"`
	ID                     string                         `json:"id"`
	StudentID              string                         `json:"student_id"`
	PlanID                 string                         `json:"plan_id"`
	CourseID               string                         `json:"course_id"`
	PlanRevision           int                            `json:"plan_revision"`
	PolicyVersion          string                         `json:"policy_version"`
	OnboardingVersion      int64                          `json:"onboarding_version"`
	BootstrapPolicyVersion string                         `json:"bootstrap_policy_version"`
	BootstrapContextDigest string                         `json:"bootstrap_context_digest"`
	CourseContentRevision  string                         `json:"course_content_revision"`
	PlanDigest             string                         `json:"plan_digest"`
	Items                  []DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem `json:"items"`
	CreatedAt              time.Time                      `json:"created_at"`
	SubmittedItems         int                            `json:"submitted_items"`
	Result                 *DiagnosticAssessmentResult    `json:"result,omitempty"`
}

// DiagnosticAssessmentResult is the only completed diagnostic projection
// returned to students. It deliberately excludes task and scorer details.
type DiagnosticAssessmentResult struct {
	Schema                string    `json:"schema"`
	StudentID             string    `json:"student_id"`
	CourseID              string    `json:"course_id"`
	CourseContentRevision string    `json:"course_content_revision"`
	PolicyVersion         string    `json:"policy_version"`
	AttemptID             string    `json:"attempt_id"`
	PlanID                string    `json:"plan_id"`
	PlanRevision          int       `json:"plan_revision"`
	Correct               int       `json:"correct"`
	Total                 int       `json:"total"`
	Percent               int       `json:"percent"`
	Band                  string    `json:"band"`
	BandPolicyVersion     string    `json:"band_policy_version"`
	PlanDigest            string    `json:"plan_digest"`
	ResultDigest          string    `json:"result_digest"`
	CompletedAt           time.Time `json:"completed_at"`
}

func DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(result DiagnosticAssessmentResult) (string, error) {
	projection := struct {
		Schema                string    `json:"schema"`
		StudentID             string    `json:"student_id"`
		CourseID              string    `json:"course_id"`
		CourseContentRevision string    `json:"course_content_revision"`
		PolicyVersion         string    `json:"policy_version"`
		AttemptID             string    `json:"attempt_id"`
		PlanID                string    `json:"plan_id"`
		PlanRevision          int       `json:"plan_revision"`
		Correct               int       `json:"correct"`
		Total                 int       `json:"total"`
		Percent               int       `json:"percent"`
		Band                  string    `json:"band"`
		BandPolicyVersion     string    `json:"band_policy_version"`
		PlanDigest            string    `json:"plan_digest"`
		CompletedAt           time.Time `json:"completed_at"`
	}{result.Schema, result.StudentID, result.CourseID, result.CourseContentRevision, result.PolicyVersion, result.AttemptID, result.PlanID, result.PlanRevision, result.Correct, result.Total, result.Percent, result.Band, result.BandPolicyVersion, result.PlanDigest, result.CompletedAt.UTC()}
	b, err := json.Marshal(projection)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(b)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

func NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentResult(result DiagnosticAssessmentResult) (DiagnosticAssessmentResult, error) {
	// Identity and versioned contract fields are canonical wire values. Do not
	// trim them: accepting whitespace would create aliases for immutable data.
	if result.Schema != "student-diagnostic-assessment-result.v1" || !validDiagnosticUUID(result.StudentID) || !validDiagnosticUUID(result.CourseID) || !validDiagnosticUUID(result.AttemptID) || !validDiagnosticUUID(result.PlanID) || result.PlanRevision < 1 || result.PolicyVersion != DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy || result.BandPolicyVersion != DiagnosticAssessmentBandPolicy || !diagnosticSHA256.MatchString(result.CourseContentRevision) || !diagnosticSHA256.MatchString(result.PlanDigest) || !diagnosticSHA256.MatchString(result.ResultDigest) || result.Total < 3 || result.Total > 5 || result.Correct < 0 || result.Correct > result.Total || result.Percent != result.Correct*100/result.Total || !canonicalDiagnosticTimestamp(result.CompletedAt) {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentResult{}, ErrValidation
	}
	band, err := DiagnosticPlacementBand(result.Correct, result.Total)
	if err != nil || result.Band != band {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentResult{}, ErrValidation
	}
	result.CompletedAt = result.CompletedAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	computed, err := DiagnosticAssessmentResultDigest(result)
	if err != nil || computed != result.ResultDigest {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentResult{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return result, nil
}

func NormalizeDiagnosticAssessmentPlan(input DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) (DiagnosticAssessmentPlan, error) {
	if input.Schema != DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchema || input.PolicyVersion != DiagnosticAssessmentPolicy ||
		input.PlanRevision < 1 || input.OnboardingVersion < 1 || input.BootstrapPolicyVersion != DiagnosticBootstrapPolicy || !diagnosticSHA256.MatchString(input.BootstrapContextDigest) || !validDiagnosticUUID(input.ID) || !validDiagnosticUUID(input.StudentID) ||
		!validDiagnosticUUID(input.CourseID) || !diagnosticSHA256.MatchString(input.CourseContentRevision) ||
		!diagnosticSHA256.MatchString(input.PlanDigest) || !canonicalDiagnosticTimestamp(input.CreatedAt) || len(input.Assessments) < 3 || len(input.Assessments) > 5 {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.CreatedAt = input.CreatedAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	items, err := normalizeDiagnosticItems(input.Assessments)
	if err != nil {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, ErrValidation
	}
	input.Assessments = items
	digest, err := DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest(input)
	if err != nil || digest != input.PlanDigest {
		return DiagnosticAssessmentPlan{}, ErrValidation
	}
	return input, nil
}

func normalizeDiagnosticItems(items []DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem) ([]DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem, error) {
	result := append([]DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem(nil), items...)
	seenTask := map[string]struct{}{}
	for index := range result {
		item := &result[index]
		if !validDiagnosticUUID(item.LessonID) || !validDiagnosticUUID(item.TaskID) || item.TaskVersion < 1 || item.LessonOrder < 0 || item.TaskOrder < 0 || !canonicalDiagnosticTimestamp(item.UpdatedAt) {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid diagnostic plan item")
		}
		if _, ok := seenTask[item.TaskID]; ok {
			return nil, errors.New("duplicate task")
		}
		seenTask[item.TaskID] = struct{}{}
		targets, err := normalizeDiagnosticTargets(item.LearningTargets)
		if err != nil || len(targets) == 0 || len(targets) > 100 {
			return nil, errors.New("invalid targets")
		}
		item.LearningTargets, item.UpdatedAt = targets, item.UpdatedAt.UTC().Truncate(time.Microsecond)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func normalizeDiagnosticTargets(values []LearningTargetRef) ([]LearningTargetRef, error) {
	if len(values) > 100 {
		return nil, ErrValidation
	}
	out := make([]LearningTargetRef, len(values))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for i, value := range values {
		value.Key = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value.Key))
		value.Version = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(value.Version))
		if (value.Type != LearningTargetConcept && value.Type != LearningTargetCapability) || !diagnosticTargetKey.MatchString(value.Key) || value.Version == "" || len(value.Version) > 64 {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		identity := string(value.Type) + "\x00" + value.Key + "\x00" + value.Version
		if seen[identity] {
			return nil, ErrValidation
		}
		seen[identity] = true
		out[i] = value
	}
	return out, nil
}
func NormalizeDiagnosticLearningTargets(values []LearningTargetRef) ([]LearningTargetRef, error) {
	return normalizeDiagnosticTargets(values)
}

// DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest uses a named struct rather than a map so its
// byte representation is stable across processes and repository adapters.
func DiagnosticAssessmentPlanDigest(plan DiagnosticAssessmentPlan) (string, error) {
	items, err := normalizeDiagnosticItems(plan.Assessments)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	projection := struct {
		Schema                 string                         `json:"schema"`
		ID                     string                         `json:"id"`
		StudentID              string                         `json:"student_id"`
		CourseID               string                         `json:"course_id"`
		PlanRevision           int                            `json:"plan_revision"`
		PolicyVersion          string                         `json:"policy_version"`
		OnboardingVersion      int64                          `json:"onboarding_version"`
		BootstrapPolicyVersion string                         `json:"bootstrap_policy_version"`
		BootstrapContextDigest string                         `json:"bootstrap_context_digest"`
		CourseContentRevision  string                         `json:"course_content_revision"`
		Assessments            []DiagnosticAssessmentPlanItem `json:"assessments"`
	}{DiagnosticAssessmentPlanSchema, plan.ID, plan.StudentID, plan.CourseID, plan.PlanRevision, plan.PolicyVersion, plan.OnboardingVersion, plan.BootstrapPolicyVersion, plan.BootstrapContextDigest, plan.CourseContentRevision, items}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(projection)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(encoded)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:]), nil
}

func DiagnosticPlacementBand(correct, total int) (string, error) {
	if total < 3 || total > 5 || correct < 0 || correct > total {
		return "", ErrValidation
	}
	percent := correct * 100 / total
	switch {
	case percent >= 80:
		return "ADVANCED", nil
	case percent >= 50:
		return "CORE", nil
	default:
		return "FOUNDATION", nil
	}
}

func validDiagnosticUUID(value string) bool {
	parsed, err := uuid.Parse(value)
	return err == nil && parsed.String() == value
}

// Planner's digest projection uses canonical wire timestamps. Do not silently
// change an offset or nanosecond value while accepting immutable input.
func canonicalDiagnosticTimestamp(value time.Time) bool {
	return !value.IsZero() && value.Location() == time.UTC && value.Nanosecond()%1000 == 0
}
